description.value: Robin Hood Inn & Suites is a motel located on Gorge Road East in Victoria, BC, positioned near the Gorge Waterway and within cycling distance of downtown Victoria. As a roadside motel-style property it would offer basic overnight accommodation for touring cyclists passing through the capital region. Its status and current operations are uncertain given the lapsed domain.
